text: I run a small embroidery business and needed a way for customers to type a name, pick a sweater color and yarn color, and see it on the product in real time. Podifai does this for free, and the live preview is a big hit with customers. The editor has more options than I found at first, including text that shrinks automatically to fit longer names. Support was responsive. I reported a mobile layout issue and a real person got back to me quickly, confirmed the bug, and passed it to their developer and fixed the problem.

The app has truly been a game changer for our business, and working with Chelsea and her team has made the experience even better. From the beginning, the app was incredibly easy to set up, navigate, and manage. Anytime we had a question or needed additional help, we reached out and received a quick response with a solution. That level of support has made such a difference. One of the biggest things I was looking for was a way to create a more interactive experience on our website without making things complicated for us or our customers. I needed something that was easy to navigate, reliable, and actually worked the way it was supposed to—and this app delivered. It has made the entire process so much easier for us, and having Chelsea and her team there when we need them has given us even more confidence in using it. I highly recommend both the app and the team behind it!

I run a jewelry website with a wide variety of custom product options, and using the Podifai plugin has been very helpful. Their team is excellent; whenever I’ve reached out with a question, they’ve responded promptly and resolved most of my issues. I look forward to continuing to work with them and wish them continued growth and success.

Great app! It's simple, user-friendly, and works exactly as expected. We reported a technical issue, and Chelsea was incredibly responsive throughout the process. She listened to our feedback, kept us updated, and implemented a proper fix. The update significantly improved our product page speed. It's great to see a founder who genuinely listens to merchants and continuously improves the product. Highly recommended!

Podifai is an excellent product customiser and has quickly become an important part of our bespoke product service. It provides a complete set of flexible templating tools, and its customisers work very well across desktop and mobile and across the multiple themes we tested. What stands out most is that the app is clearly being developed with real merchants in mind, and the team is steadily improving it based on feedback. The support has been exceptional. Chelsea and the team are responsive, knowledgeable and genuinely interested in understanding how we use the app. They engage thoughtfully with our feedback, prioritise useful improvements and have been very hands-on with setup, theme integration and ensuring ongoing compatibility with a wide range of Shopify marketplace themes. We use Maestroo’s Prestige theme, and they have been particularly helpful in making sure everything works properly. We are very happy to be using Podifai for our new bespoke service.

I’m so glad I found Podifai. The support has been outstanding — I even spoke directly with the owner/founder, who was incredibly helpful and genuinely invested in my success. Podifai helped me get on target when I was close to giving up. The product itself is super easy to use. My advice: start with one of the pre‑built templates that closely matches what you’re trying to do. Once I did that, everything fell into place. I saved my template, and now it’s just rinse‑and‑repeat for every new product. Before Podifai, I tried two other customization apps and wasted a lot of time, money, and effort only to discover they couldn’t meet my requirements. It was frustrating and discouraging. Podifai met my needs immediately, and with their support, I truly believe I can make my project happen instead of abandoning it. Good luck to Podifai — and to anyone else starting their customization journey. This app made all the difference for me.

This is exactly what I have been looking for and the price is right! The basic features are exactly what I need. I love the live preview! I use a similar live preview with my amazon store, so I love having a similar feature for my website. I have tried several other live previewers and they either cost way more than shopify each month, or were far more complicated and still couldn't give me the same features.

Podifai was easy to pick up from day one. The interface is clear, so I could find what I needed without spending much time learning the app. I also really appreciate the support team. They’ve been thoughtful and helpful whenever I’ve had a question.
Great. Exactly what we were looking for. Good functionality, and also really nice that they reached out to offer extra assistance.
Very easy to use! Chelsea offers round the clock support and tutorials so help achieve any outcome. Works perfectly!
Chelsea is the absolute best. Customer service second to none, for sure. Good app, even better support. KUDOS!!!!
Amazing experience! Chelsea and her team have been beyond helpful in getting me set up and adjusting to my needs. New features have been added and I couldn't be happier with this app. Thank you!!

Podifai has been great for our store. The performance and UI are excellent. We are able to set up our product options without ever opening a guide - it's that easy. We tried other options apps before this, and they either had a steep learning curve or slowed down the product page. Podifai does neither. Highly recommend this app.
使用這款應用程式有一段時間了，功能設置操作很直觀，減少學習的成本，重要的是他們的團隊在處理問題時積極的響應態度，讓我覺得很棒，每次遇到問題進行反饋時，他們在很短的時間就會給予回覆，並且給出針對問題排查的原因，解決方案和上線時間，這讓我覺得使用他們的應用感到很放心

Highly recommend! Nothing was ever too much trouble for the support team. The setup was easy, and the Podifai team provided fantastic support to get the app set up exactly how I wanted. Great service from start to finish!

After testing several of the major product customization apps available on the Shopify App Store, I decided to go with Podifai, and I'm very happy with my choice. First, I don't need a lot of flashy or overly complicated features. Podifai provides exactly what I need: real-time preview and image upload, and both work very well for my business. Second, what impressed me the most was the developer's responsiveness. Every time I had a question or suggestion, I received a prompt and thoughtful reply. That level of support is rare and makes a huge difference. Finally, Podifai is currently free to use during its launch period, making it an excellent opportunity to try it without any risk. I highly recommend downloading and giving it a try. It's clear that a lot of care and effort has gone into building this app, and I'm excited to see how it continues to improve.
This is a fantastic customization app. It has all of the features we need in a simple, user-friendly, and beautiful interface. Customer service is great as well. Highly recommend!
It offers a wide range of convenient features, and any issues can be resolved quickly and smoothly through chat. I’m very satisfied with the overall experience!

The options available are great for engraving customisations on my products. The support team have been amazing with helping to guide me and make my set up quicker, look and feel the way I hoped. Thank you Podifai team!

This is an excellent app for custom‑product stores. It helps us optimize and build plenty of custom features. The team listens carefully to our feedback for further development. The support team responds promptly and is always ready to assist with any issues. The customizer runs steadily on our storefront. Highly recommended for merchants selling personalized items.

The perfect Product Customizer app! With a wide range of possibilites already there, and a continuing development by Chelsea and her team, this is the app for everyone who wants to have a live preview for customization in the shop. Very easily managed and with a true pro-team behind!

Probably one of the only apps where I genuinely feel that a lot of love and research has gone into it, created by someone who is passionate about providing a solution that is essentially plug-and-play and just works. I don't currently have a need for the live customisation features, but it's nice knowing they're there if I ever want to use them in the future. The fact that it's free is a bonus, but I would genuinely have no issue paying for this app, knowing that it supports an Australian business and a developer who is passionate about continually improving their product.
Great app with wonderful support! Very easy to use and set up. Looking forward to the multiple views and multiple image upload features. Highly recommended!
Super application pour des produits personnalisés, les développeurs sont aussi très réactifs et nous aident à aller encore plus loin. Je recommande !
Molto soddisfatta dell'assistenza che mi ha aiutata e guidata in una mia richiesta. Super disponibile ad ascoltare se avete delle modifiche da fare o da aggiungere. Consiglio questa applicazione !

Love Podifai, customizing your products has never been that simple. The team behind it is great, they respond immediately and try to sort it out for you. The app gets new features constantly and can't wait to see how far it'll go. Thank you for your hard work and making our work way easier.
I love this app. It ties my website together beautifully and is also aesthetically pleasing to use. The developer is a fantastic communicator, too, which made setup and tweaks really easy.

This app is AMAZING! So simple to use and the personalisation options are so much better than what's currently on the market. I found it very easy to use, and the fact that I can allow my customers to individually customise their order depending on which product they buy is so advanced. Not to mention the tech support! I had an issue with it displaying on my website because of my theme, and I got help instantly to the point where I didn't have to do anything. I just had to give access, and it was done in a matter of hours, like in 1 hour! Yeah, its a game changer!
